'''Musori's gang''' operated in the city of [[Noua]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Telerath/Legends|Telerath]] during and after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Led by the Boss [[Musori]], it was at rival with [[Ken-Kiba's spice runner gang]], which also operated in the city. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] [[Ember Chankeli]] hired former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Dass Jennir]] to [[Skirmish on Telerath|deal]] with the gang, without telling him that the reason was to allow the spice runner's to fully take their place. The gang was eventually made leader-less and its members few when Dass Jennir tricked the spicers into attacking them after he made them believe Musori had ordered an attack on the spicer's operations on Telerath's second moon.
